stories.title: Noon Sunday deadline set in Iowa Army blast challenge; Fort Madison says detonation could come Monday or Tuesday
stories.summary: Fort Madison says the Iowa Army detonation could happen Monday or Tuesday. An appeals court ordered a response to the stay request by noon Sunday.

stories.title: Army plans to detonate lead azide by Tuesday, citing growing explosion risk from freezing temperatures
stories.summary: The Army said it plans to invoke an emergency exemption to federal hazardous waste regulations that would allow it to proceed without the EPA's emergency permit.

stories.title: Officials respond to apartment fire in Johnston Saturday afternoon
stories.summary: No injuries were reported, according to authorities.

stories.title: Des Moines police searching for suspect in Lower Beaver shooting, 1 injured
stories.summary: Detectives have identified a suspect, and police said there is no ongoing threat to the neighborhood.

stories.title: 4 injured, Slater man surrenders to authorities after firing shots, assault
stories.summary: 59-year-old Joseph Lavarta of Slater was arrested Friday after firing shots into a home and then assaulting the man who lived there.

stories.title: Iowa receives $750K federal grant to support sexual assault victims
stories.summary: The Attorney General Office's Victim Assistance Section received a grant totaling $750,000 to provide medical trainings aimed at supporting sexual assault victims.

stories.title: Iowa leaders share concerns, information ahead of planned lead azide detonation
stories.summary: Community members in Middletown and other areas of southeastern Iowa are bracing for a lead dust cloud as the U.S. Army plans to detonate about 5 tons of chemicals.

stories.title: Amazon drone deliveries could soon take flight in central Iowa
stories.summary: Amazon's drone delivery service may be a reality in central Iowa, pending approval from the FAA.

stories.title: Lawsuit seeking to stop planned detonation of lead azide in Iowa
stories.summary: The lawsuit challenges a permit the EPA granted the Army to move forward with the detonation.

stories.title: Senator-elect Josh Turek calls for Army to delay Friday's lead azide detonation
stories.summary: Turek is asking that the detonation be paused until public officials and residents can fully understand the health risks and precautions being taken.

stories.title: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' may have some gamers opting out of work Thursday
stories.summary: A new study shows gamers may be "out sick" Thursday for GTA VI's release, whichmay be remembered as a cultural moment.

stories.title: Des Moines gamers anticipate long-awaited midnight launch of Grand Theft Auto 6
stories.summary: The video game releases on the X-Box Series X and S and Playstation 5 on Thursday at midnight local time.
